artifact_inventory.description: Deterministic NumPy verification of sharp condition-number equality families and the radius-uniform fixed-gradient bound.
Verified deterministic output of the numerical checks.

limitations: Exact arithmetic and real SPD quadratic models only. The guarantee concerns predicted quadratic model reduction rather than actual nonlinear-objective reduction, step-distance approximation, finite-precision stability or runtime. Indefinite models admit no analogous positive universal factor. Exact trust-region and richer approximate subproblem solvers may substantially outperform the Cauchy point. Broad classical trust-region monographs and older literature leave residual historical-equivalence risk.
record_title: Sharp fraction-of-optimal decrease for the SPD Cauchy trust-region point
scientific_context: For a real SPD quadratic trust-region subproblem, the Cauchy point achieves at least 1/[(u^TBu)(u^TB^{-1}u)] of the exact predicted model decrease for every trust radius. Kantorovich yields the sharp condition-number-only factor 4kappa/(kappa+1)^2, so any fraction-of-Cauchy decrease implies an explicit sharp fraction-of-optimal decrease on uniformly SPD models.
